belief: The Premier League Asia Trophy is held biennially (every two years). This is confirmed by multiple sources including Wikipedia, the official Premier League website, and ESPN.

author: worker_2
belief: The Premier League Asia Trophy is held in Asia. Evidence shows it has been hosted in Hong Kong, Malaysia, Thailand, China, and Singapore.

author: worker_3
belief: The Premier League Asia Trophy is attended by many people. Attendance figures range from approximately 30,000-52,000+ per match, with cumulative tournament attendance reaching nearly 82,000. The 2015 event broke attendance records with 52,107 fans at the final and 81,974 total over two days.
